title: Roasted Butternut Squash Casserole
description: A delicious and comforting casserole made with roasted butternut squash, perfect for a cold winter evening.
instructions: Toss the butternut squash with 1 tablespoon of oil and season with salt and nutmeg.
Spread the squash on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
In a large skillet, sauté the onion and garlic in 1 tablespoon of oil until softened.
Add the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Slowly add the milk, whisking continuously. Bring to a simmer.
Remove from heat and stir in the gjetost cheese until melted.
In a large casserole dish, combine the roasted squash, cheese sauce, and chopped onion.
Transfer to the oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
